source_text: The persistence of cutting despite billions in funding—such as the Joint Programme's focus on attitude shifts yielding only modest, non-sustained behavioral changes—suggests campaigns overlook practitioner perspectives that prioritize cultural continuity over Western-framed harm narratives.
